title: Driver Vehicle Inspection Authorization Form
subtitle: Driver Vehicle Inspection: bounds the decision, conditions, and expiry.
description: Driver Vehicle Inspection Authorization Form binds power unit, trailer, safety equipment, visible defect, driver report, and release status to a named transport decision, commercial or operating limit, effective time, and the carrier / fleet safety authority's confirmation. The fleet dispatch coordinator records the requested Driver Vehicle Inspection action and keeps any variance outside the granted authority.
use_case: Use Driver Vehicle Inspection Authorization Form at yard, roadside safe area, vehicle cab, exterior walkaround, and trailer. Reconcile applicable Driver Vehicle Inspection requirements with the load, carrier, rate, claim, equipment, document, or inventory boundary that applies. Capture the carrier / fleet safety authority's approval, counteroffer, hold, or decline, then reauthorize any change to power unit, trailer, safety equipment, visible defect, driver report, and release status.

sections.title: Carrier and shipment identity
sections.guidance: Identify the Driver Vehicle Inspection request, named decision maker, contact, effective time, and subject.

blocks.label: Driver Vehicle Inspection identity

fields.label: Vehicle, unit, plate, odometer, and trailer

blocks.guidance: Use the Driver Vehicle Inspection identifier printed on power unit, trailer, safety equipment, visible defect, driver report, and release status or its linked source record.

sections.title: Requested authorization and task details
sections.guidance: List each Driver Vehicle Inspection action with its quantity, amount, route, custody, or time limit.

blocks.label: Driver Vehicle Inspection authorization checks
items: Tires, wheels, fasteners, and visible inflation
Lights, reflectors, mirrors, glazing, and wipers
Brakes, steering, suspension, coupling, and visible leaks
Horn, warning devices, emergency equipment, and restraints
Load securement, doors, landing gear, and trailer condition
Defect classification, restriction, repair, and release
blocks.guidance: Confirm the Driver Vehicle Inspection facts supporting each listed action.

sections.title: Authorization exception and restrictions
sections.guidance: Stop Driver Vehicle Inspection at the stated boundary and obtain renewed consent for a material variance.

blocks.label: Do not proceed without renewed authorization
blocks.guidance: Stop normal processing when a safety-critical defect, inspection limitation, repair verification, or qualified release remains unresolved. Protect power unit, trailer, safety equipment, visible defect, driver report, and release status; record the Driver Vehicle Inspection notification and obtain renewed authorization from carrier / fleet safety authority before continuing.

blocks.label: Conditions requiring a hold or renewed authorization
blocks.guidance: Identify the affected power unit, trailer, safety equipment, visible defect, driver report, and release status scope, preserve the stated limit, and contact carrier / fleet safety authority before continuing.

fields.label: Variance instruction
options: Contact decision maker before any variance

blocks.label: Evidence reviewed with the decision maker
blocks.guidance: Attach or link proof for power unit, trailer, safety equipment, visible defect, driver report, and release status; mark only Driver Vehicle Inspection evidence present in that record.
